purpose: Predeclared baseline screen for v58 validation protocol; this is not final holdout evidence.
reserved_final_candidate_design: 50 fresh seeds x 2 seats x 11 opponents = 1100 matches for the exact final artifact, after code freeze; no code tuning or opponent/seed changes during this run.

requested_100_percent_sweep.design: Five seeds, both seats, one game per seed-seat combination.
requested_100_percent_sweep.criterion: 10/10 strict wins against each of the eight historical agents, reported separately from the broader readiness gate.

selection_rules: This screen is for protocol and baseline characterization only; it cannot be used as final candidate holdout evidence.
Use all listed seeds, both seats, and every listed opponent. Do not remove games or substitute seeds based on outcomes.
A failed or timed-out match is an error and fails the error gate; document reruns separately and retain the original record.
Keep paired seed blocks intact for uncertainty calculations.
Do not modify agents/main.py or submit to Kaggle.

final_readiness_gate.top_ten_claim: Not inferable from offline games alone; require current official leaderboard evidence from an authorized submission plus head-to-head public replay evidence against current top entries.
